name: apple-workout
title: Workout
description: One workout as Apple records it: what kind it was, when it began and ended, and the numbers a watch or phone measured. Every field is optional, because a workout carries only what its device measured. A route is a GPX file attached to the record's entry and is not a field.

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: HealthKit's name for the kind of workout, in lower camel case, such as running or traditionalStrengthTraining. It is the same in every language.

activity_name.title: Activity name
activity_name.description: The name Apple wrote for the activity, in the words the person saw.

start.title: Start
start.description: When the workout began, ISO 8601 with its offset from UTC.

end.title: End
end.description: When the workout ended, ISO 8601 with its offset from UTC.

average_heart_rate_bpm.title: Average heart rate
average_heart_rate_bpm.description: Beats per minute, averaged over the workout.
